s.note: the camp outside the Quidditch World Cup
s.how: Fry 8 pork sausages slowly in a heavy pan until sticky. Fry 2 sliced onions in butter until golden. Put in 8 soft rolls with the onions and a good squirt of brown sauce.

s.note: the first task with the dragons
s.how: Slice 300g chorizo and fry in a hot pan until crisp. Add 2 tbsp honey and a pinch of chilli flakes and cook until sticky. Spear on toothpicks with cubes of 150g sharp cheddar.

m.note: the Christmas feast before the dancing
m.how: Roast a 2kg beef rib roast at 220C for 20 minutes then 160C to 52C and rest. Roast 1kg potatoes. Bake Yorkshires from 3 eggs, 150g flour and 300ml milk at 220C. Glaze 4 carrots with honey. Make gravy with 200ml red wine.

w.note: the frozen Great Hall decorated for the ball
w.how: Whip 4 whites to soft peaks, add 220g caster sugar until glossy, then fold in 1 tsp cornflour. Bake at 120C for 90 minutes and cool in the oven. Top with 300ml whipped cream, 50g white chocolate shavings and 250g berries dusted with icing sugar.

d.note: a cold winter night at the castle
d.how: Simmer 1.5L cloudy apple juice with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, orange peel and 2 star anise for 15 minutes. Strain and serve warm in mugs.
